SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF  EXISTS t_harm2;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS  t_harm2 (PRIMARY KEY(hospcode,pid,seq) ) ENGINE=MyISAM IGNORE AS
SELECT
p.HOSPCODE,p.PID,s.SEQ,s.date_serv,d.DIAGCODE,d.DIAGTYPE,c.DIDSTD
FROM tmp_diag_opd d 
	INNER JOIN tmp_service s ON d.HOSPCODE=s.hospcode AND d.PID=s.pid AND d.SEQ=s.seq
	INNER JOIN tmp_drug_opd  c ON s.hospcode=c.HOSPCODE AND s.pid=c.PID AND s.seq=c.SEQ
	INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON s.hospcode=p.HOSPCODE AND s.pid=p.PID
	INNER JOIN  chospital h ON p.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE d.DIAGTYPE IN(1) AND s.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  AND 
		(SUBSTR(d.DIAGCODE,1,3)  BETWEEN 'F11' AND 'F16' OR SUBSTR(d.DIAGCODE,1,3)  BETWEEN 'F18' AND 'F19')
		AND SUBSTR(c.DIDSTD,1,11) IN('10139600000','10077013300','10223200000')  AND p.NATION IN(99) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9) ;


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_harm2(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	pid_q1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seq_q1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pid_q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seq_q2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pid_q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seq_q3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	pid_q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	seq_q4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_harm2 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_harm2
(
 SELECT @id,h.hoscode ,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(10,11,12),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(10,11,12),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(1,2,3),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(1,2,3),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(4,5,6),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(4,5,6),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(7,8,9),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid),null)) pid_q4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(d.date_serv,'%m') IN(7,8,9),CONCAT(d.HOSPCODE,'-',d.pid,'-',d.seq),null)) seq_q4
FROM t_harm2 d 
	INNER JOIN  chospital h ON d.hospcode=h.hoscode
GROUP BY d.hospcode);

- ผู้รับบริการจากแฟ้ม Diagnosis_opd รหัส ICD10 F11-16,F18-19 และ
- Diagtype =1 และ
- มีรหัสยา 11 หลักแรก ในแฟ้ม Drug_opd เป็น '10139600000','10077013300','10223200000'

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("pid_q1"+"pid_q2"+"pid_q3"+"pid_q4") AS pid ,SUM("seq_q1"+"seq_q2"+"seq_q3"+"seq_q4") AS seq ,SUM("pid_q1") AS "pid_q1" ,SUM("seq_q1") AS "seq_q1" ,SUM("pid_q2") AS "pid_q2" ,SUM("seq_q2") AS "seq_q2" ,SUM("pid_q3") AS "pid_q3" ,SUM("seq_q3") AS "seq_q3" ,SUM("pid_q4") AS "pid_q4" ,SUM("seq_q4") AS "seq_q4"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

rows.query_areacode:
SELECT
SUM(pid_q1+pid_q2+pid_q3+pid_q4) AS pid
,SUM(seq_q1+seq_q2+seq_q3+seq_q4) AS seq

,SUM(pid_q1) AS pid_q1
,SUM(seq_q1) AS seq_q1
